claimText: C major - scale and chords for both hands
outcomeNote: Found by the music-domain review, then by the check's new overlap rule: in section B the right-hand I chords of bars 6 and 7 sat on C4-E4-G4 while the left-hand scale struck C4, one key for two hands. Both chords moved up an octave (C5-E5-G5); nothing else changed.
